questions.stem: Why is sodium hydrogencarbonate solution sometimes added to the water in pondweed photosynthesis experiments?

options.text: To increase the oxygen concentration in the water
To provide a source of carbon dioxide for the pondweed
To change the pH of the water to alkaline
To prevent the growth of bacteria in the water

questions.explanation: Sodium hydrogencarbonate releases carbon dioxide into the water, ensuring that CO2 concentration is not a limiting factor during the experiment.
